// diagnostic

E2806

Convention file `{path}` has no `fn page`.

What

Convention file `{path}` has no `fn page`.

Why

Files under a `.routes(from:)` root must declare `fn page` or start with `_` to opt out. A file without a page would register an endpoint the compiler cannot analyze.

Fix

add `fn page()`, rename the file with a leading `_`, or remove it from the routes directory.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2806: tests/ui/web_app_routes_stray.stderr.

Error [E2806]: convention file `routes_stray/stray.jet` has no `fn page`
  --> tests/ui/web_app_routes_stray.jet:4:30
    |
  4 | fn run() => App :: web.app().routes(from: "routes_stray").csr()
    |                              ^^^^^^
 Why: every file under a `.routes(from:)` root must declare `fn page` or start with `_` to opt out (D-WEBAUTHOR1)
 Fix: add `fn page()`, rename the file with a leading `_`, or remove it from the routes directory
